QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the Memory Keeper, you must return to where everything first started to regain your memories. Adventures? Does he mean when you had your first awakening as a Kaiser? Or when you first arranged Heliseum Force with Tear and Velderoth?
